excerpt.zh: 我们的食物赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our food deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 我们的食物赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
texts.en: Our food deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 我们帝国面临的食物短缺问题正变得越来越严重。显然我们必须采取果断行动，否则短缺将在几个月内达到极限。
texts.en: The food shortages befalling our empire are becoming increasingly problematic. It is clear that we will have to take decisive action, otherwise the shortages will become terminal within a matter of months.

label.en: Everything is going according to plan.

texts.zh: 我们的食物债务已经无可救药。大幅削减将会强制执行，我们将别无选择接受破产并重组我们的契约。
texts.en: Our food debt has become terminal. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, as we have no choice but to accept bankruptcy and default on our obligations.

texts.zh: 我们的食物耗尽了。我们无法再为子个体或其他需要食物以维持运转的实体提供给养。大幅削减将会强制执行，我们别无选择，只能对我们的资源分发系统强制执行大规模重组。
texts.en: Our food has run out. We simply cannot provide any sustenance to the drones and other entities that require it to function. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, as we have no choice but to make large-scale reallocations to our resource distribution system.

texts.zh: 我们或许最珍视之物——自然资源的平衡——已经失守。我们的给养储备已经耗尽，导致整个食物链陷入困境。为了确保最大的生存机会，我们现在必须采取严厉的配给制和大规模的资源重新分配。
texts.en: That which we perhaps hold most precious - the balance of our natural resources - has failed. Our feed stocks have run out, causing distress throughout the food web. We must now resort to harsh rationing and large-scale reallocation of resources in order to ensure the greatest chance for survival.
